README.md · Author-provided

objc2-core-data

Latest version License Documentation CI

Rust bindings to Apple's framework CoreData.

This README is kept intentionally small to consolidate the documentation, see the Rust docs for more details on this crate.

This crate is part of the objc2 project, see that for related crates.

[rust]
name = "objc2_core_data"
type = "lib"
edition = "2021"
build-script = false

[dependencies]
bitflags = { loaf = "crates-io/bitflags", version = "^2.5.0", features = ["std"], default-features = false, optional = true }
block2 = { loaf = "crates-io/block2", version = ">=0.6.1, <0.8.0", features = ["alloc"], default-features = false, optional = true }
objc2 = { loaf = "crates-io/objc2", version = ">=0.6.2, <0.8.0", features = ["std"], default-features = false }
objc2-cloud-kit = { loaf = "crates-io/objc2-cloud-kit", version = "^0.3.2", features = ["CKContainer", "CKDatabase", "CKRecord", "CKRecordID", "CKRecordZoneID", "CKShare", "CKShareMetadata", "CKShareParticipant", "CKUserIdentityLookupInfo"], default-features = false, optional = true }
objc2-core-spotlight = { loaf = "crates-io/objc2-core-spotlight", version = "^0.3.2", features = ["CSSearchableIndex", "CSSearchableItemAttributeSet"], default-features = false, optional = true, target = "cfg(not(any(target_os = \"tvos\", target_os = \"watchos\")))" }
objc2-foundation = { loaf = "crates-io/objc2-foundation", version = "^0.3.2", features = ["alloc"], default-features = false }

Reporting & security

Abuse reporting and a confidential registry security contact are not configured in this playground. No report is sent here.

For a package vulnerability, follow its upstream repository’s security policy. You can find its source link in the package’s Metadata section.

Add to your project

Add this exact indexed version to loaf.toml.

[dependencies]
objc2-core-data = { loaf = "crates-io/objc2-core-data", version = "=0.3.2" }
